name: Gemini 2.0 Flash
description: Fast, versatile multimodal model with native tool use.
longDescription: Gemini 2.0 Flash is a fast and efficient multimodal model supporting text, images, video, and audio. It features native tool use, multimodal generation, and a balance of speed and intelligence ideal for production applications.
limitations: Less capable than 2.5 Pro on hard reasoning

from google import genai

client = genai.Client()
response = client.models.generate_content(
    model="gemini-2.0-flash",
    contents="Hello!"
)
print(response.text)
